title: Zaren inji, wando, maɓalli da zips

say: Zaren inji, wando, maɓalli da zips.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don module na biyu na Basic Tailoring da Gyaran Tufafi.
Wannan tsarin yana game da ayyukan da abokan ciniki ke nema. Da farko, kuna zaren injin ku kuma karanta ɗinkin da ya yi.

say: Sa'an nan kuma ku yanke wando, tsayi iri ɗaya akan ƙafafu biyu.

say: Mataki na daya. Ɗaga ƙafar matsi. Wannan yana buɗe fayafai na tashin hankali don zaren ya zauna a tsakanin su.

say: Mataki na biyu. Juya dabaran hannu zuwa gare ku har allura da lebar ɗaukar sama sun kasance a mafi girman wurinsu.

say: Mataki na uku. Daga reel, jagoranci zaren ta hanyar jagorar saman, sannan saukar da tashar ta hanyar yankin tashin hankali da kuma kewayen U-juyawa.

say: Mataki na hudu. Kawo shi kuma ku haɗa shi ta hanyar lever ɗin ɗauka. Yawancin tangles sun zo daga rasa wannan.

say: Mataki na biyar. Sauko da shi ta hanyar jagororin kuma zaren allura, sa'an nan kuma ja 10 zuwa 15 cm ta ciki.
Idan ƙafar tana ƙasa yayin da kuke zaren, zaren ya rasa fayafai kuma kuna samun gida na madaukai a ƙasa.

panel.rule: Zare tare da matsi ƙafa UP

say: Daidaitaccen dinki yana kallon iri ɗaya a bangarorin biyu. Dinka na yau da kullun a kusan mm 2.5, tare da juzu'i uku ko huɗu a kowane ƙarshen.
Misali, Ngozi tana samun madaukai a kasa. Ta sake maimaita saman, kuma dinkin ya daidaita. Bata tab'a tab'a d'akin tashin hankali ba.

panel.heading: Matsalolin dinki na gama-gari guda uku

cards.d: Yawanci zaren sama. Tada ƙafa kuma sake zana saman daga farkon.
Babban tashin hankali ya matse sosai. Rage tashin hankali na sama kadan.
Canza allura. Tsaftace lint daga karnukan ciyarwa da yankin bobbin.

say: Idan zaren bobbin ya nuna a sama, rage tashin hankali na sama.

say: Kafin a cire, bincika zip ɗin. Idan haƙoran suna da kyau amma sun rabu a buɗe a bayan faifan, ana sawa maɗaurin. Misali, Uche ya dace da sabon faifai mai girman girman kan siket na Chioma cikin kusan mintuna 20.

panel.heading: Fara gano zip ɗin
left: An buɗe rarrabuwa a bayan faifai

say: Idan hakora sun ɓace ko tef ɗin ya tsage, maye gurbin duka zip ɗin. Da farko, sannan a dinka da kafar zik ​​din.
Kada a taɓa ɗinke haƙoran ƙarfe ko tasha. Alurar ta karye kuma guda na iya tashi zuwa idanunka, don haka juya dabaran a hankali da hannu a wurin.

panel.heading: Fara gano zip ɗin
left: An buɗe rarrabuwa a bayan faifai

say: Koyaushe kudin aiki. Misali, Kemi a Ibadan ta sa wando biyu na ofis da hannu. Farashin anan yana da ƙima.
Zare guda biyu kusan naira 50 ne.
Kowane biyu yana ɗaukar kusan mintuna 40, don haka mintuna 80. Kusan naira 1,500 a awa daya, lokacinta ya kai kusan naira 2,000.
Ta kara kusan Naira 200 na kudin wuta da na aiki.

Jimlar kudin, Naira 2,250. Masu sana’ar dinki na cikin gida suna karbar kusan 1,500 a kowane guda biyu, don haka tana karbar 3,000 duka biyun, wanda ya biya lokacinta kuma ya bar kusan Naira 750 riba.
Ayyukanku: zare da tsaftace injin ku, rage tsohuwar wando da 3 cm, dinka maɓalli biyu tare da shank, sa'annan ku maye gurbin zip kuma ku gyara sutura.
Yanzu ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Yanzu ka gwada
items: Zare, gwada kuma tsaftace injin ku
A rage tsofaffin wando da santimita 3
Dinka maɓallai biyu tare da ɗigon zaren zaren
Sauya zip kuma gyara sutura
